# React Timeline Editor

Source: https://github.com/xzdarcy/react-timeline-editor/blob/master/README.md

# React Timeline Editor

**[React Timeline Editor](https://zdarcy.com/)** is a react component used to quickly build a timeline animation editor.

![example](https://github.com/xzdarcy/react-timeline-editor/blob/f79d85eee8a723e5210c04232daf2c51888418c0/public/assets/timeline.gif)
## Getting Started

```bash
npm install @xzdarcy/react-timeline-editor
```

```ts
import { Timeline, TimelineEffect, TimelineRow } from '@xzdarcy/react-timeline-editor';
import React from 'react';

const mockData: TimelineRow[] = [{
    id: "0",
    actions: [
      {
        id: "action00",
        start: 0,
        end: 2,
        effectId: "effect0",
      },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: "1",
    actions: [
      {
        id: "action10",
        start: 1.5,
        end: 5,
        effectId: "effect1",
      }
    ],
}]

const mockEffect: Record<string, TimelineEffect> = {
  effect0: {
    id: "effect0",
    name: "效果0",
  },
  effect1: {
    id: "effect1",
    name: "效果1",
  },
};

const TimelineEditor = () => {
  return (
      <Timeline
        editorData={mockData}
        effects={mockEffect}
      />
  );
};
```

## Documention
Checkout the [Docs](https://zdarcy.com/) for a demonstration of some basic and advanced features.

# 102-scale-customization.mdx

Source: https://github.com/xzdarcy/react-timeline-editor/blob/master/packages/document/docs/en/guide/editor/102-scale-customization.mdx

title: Scale Customization

### Scale Customization

+ scale: Single scale mark category (>0)
+ scaleSplitCount: Number of subdivided units per scale (>0 integer)
+ scaleWidth: Display width of a single scale (>0, unit: px)
+ startLeft: Distance from the left side where the scale starts (>=0, unit: px)

<code src="@src/editor-demo/editor-scale-customization/index.tsx"></code>

# 111-drag.mdx

Source: https://github.com/xzdarcy/react-timeline-editor/blob/master/packages/document/docs/en/guide/editor/111-drag.mdx

title: Drag Timeline Row

### Row Drag

> Use the drag handle on the left to adjust the order of rows

<code src="@src/editor-demo/editor-drag" direction="vertical" />

### Drag Related Callbacks

> A series of callback functions are triggered during the drag process, which can be used to implement custom logic

<code src="@src/editor-demo/editor-drag" direction="vertical" />

### Drag API Description

#### enableRowDrag

Whether to enable row drag functionality, default is `false`

```typescript
type enableRowDrag = boolean;
```

#### onRowDragStart

Callback when row drag starts

```typescript
type onRowDragStart = (params: { row: TimelineRow }) => void;
```

#### onRowDragEnd

Callback when row drag ends

```typescript
type onRowDragEnd = (params: { row: TimelineRow; editorData: TimelineRow[] }) => void;
```

# 101-intro.mdx

Source: https://github.com/xzdarcy/react-timeline-editor/blob/master/packages/document/docs/en/guide/engine/101-intro.mdx

title: Engine Introduction
order: 1
nav:
  title: Engine
  order: 2
group:
  title: Runner

## Runner

We provide a runner that is decoupled from the editor for running the data produced by the editor.

You can implement your own running system by defining the running capabilities (audio playback, animation playback, etc.) in each<code><a href="/en/guide/intro/3-data-interface.html#timelineeffect">TimelineEffect</a></code>.

+ 🛠 Provides capabilities such as setting time and running rate
+ ⚙️ Can be used independently

## Examples

You can use the runner in the following two scenarios:

### Running During Editing
> The editor has a built-in runner and provides<code><a href="/en/guide/intro/3-data-interface.html#timelinestate">TimelineState</a></code>for more convenient control of the runner.
> 
> We do not provide default runner styles; you need to customize the styles
> 
> You can easily obtain running data changes through listeners to customize your own runner style

<code src="@src/engine-demo/engine-basic/index.tsx"></code>

### Using Independently

> You can also use the runner anywhere to run the data produced by the editor
> 
> This is very useful when you want to share a set of data and running capabilities between `editing` and `runtime`

<code src="@src/engine-demo/engine-standalone/index.tsx"></code>

---

# 102-api.mdx

Source: https://github.com/xzdarcy/react-timeline-editor/blob/master/packages/document/docs/en/guide/engine/102-api.mdx

title: Runner API

### isPlaying

`boolean` Whether the runner is currently running

### isPaused

`boolean` Whether the runner is stopped

### effects

*setter*  [TimelineEffect](/en/guide/intro/3-data-interface.html#timelineeffect)  Running effects

### data
*setter*  [TimelineRow](/en/guide/intro/3-data-interface.html#timelinerow)[] Running data

### setPlayRate

`(rate: number) => void` Set playback rate

### getPlayRate

`() => number` Get playback rate

### setTime

`(time: number) => void` Set playback time

### getTime

`() => number` Get playback time

### reRender

`() => void` Re-render current time

### play

`(param: {toTime?: number; autoEnd?: boolean}) => boolean` 

Start playing from current time (can be set via `setTime`), returns whether playing is successful
+ toTime (optional): Playback end time 
+ autoEnd (optional): Whether to automatically stop after playing all actions

```ts | pure
import { TimelineEngine } from '@xzdarcy/react-timeline-editor';
const engine = new TimelineEngine();
engine.play({autoEnd: true})
```

### pause

`() => void` Pause

### listener

You can listen to some events provided by the runner and respond with logic

```ts | pure
import { TimelineEngine } from '@xzdarcy/react-timeline-editor';
const engine = new TimelineEngine();
```

+ `setTimeByTick`: Time changes caused by runner tick
```ts | pure
engine.on('setTimeByTick', ({time, engine}) => {...})
```

+ `beforeSetTime`: Before setting time (manually) (can prevent setting by `return false`)
```ts | pure
engine.on('beforeSetTime', ({time, engine}) => {...})
```

+ `afterSetTime`: After setting time (manually)
```ts | pure
engine.on('afterSetTime', ({time, engine}) => {...})
```

+ `beforeSetPlayRate`: Before setting running rate (can prevent setting by `return false`)
```ts | pure
engine.on('beforeSetPlayRate', ({rate, engine}) => {...})
```

+ `afterSetPlayRate`: After setting running rate
```ts | pure
engine.on('afterSetPlayRate', ({rate, engine}) => {...})

```

+ `play`: Listen to play event
```ts | pure
engine.on('play', ({engine}) => {...})
```

+ `paused`: Listen to pause event
```ts | pure
engine.on('paused', ({engine}) => {...})
```

+ `ended`: Listen to play completion event
```ts | pure
engine.on('ended', ({engine}) => {...})
```

# 1-getting-started.md

Source: https://github.com/xzdarcy/react-timeline-editor/blob/master/packages/document/docs/en/guide/intro/1-getting-started.md

title: Getting Started

`react-timeline-editor` is a React-based component for quickly building timeline editing capabilities.

It can be mainly used to build animation editors, video editors, etc.

![timeline](/assets/timeline.gif)

## Installation

```
npm install @xzdarcy/react-timeline-editor
```

```tsx | pure
import React from 'react';
import { Timeline } from '@xzdarcy/react-timeline-editor';

export const TimelineEditor = () => {
  return (
    <Timeline     
      editorData={[]}
      effects={{}}
    />
  )
}
```

# 3-data-interface.mdx

Source: https://github.com/xzdarcy/react-timeline-editor/blob/master/packages/document/docs/en/guide/intro/3-data-interface.mdx

title: Data Interface

## TimelineRow
> Editor Data: Edit Row Data Structure

import { TimelineRow } from '@src/api/TimelineRow';

<TimelineRow />

## TimelineAction
> Editor Data: Action Data Structure

import { TimelineAction } from '@src/api/TimelineAction';

<TimelineAction />

## TimelineEffect
> Editor Running Effect Data Structure

import { TimelineEffect } from '@src/api/TimelineEffect';   

<TimelineEffect />

### TimeLineEffectSource
> Editor Running Effect Source Data Structure

+ start -- Trigger Condition
  + Triggered when the runner starts playing, if the time is within the current action time range
+ enter -- Trigger Condition
  + Entering the current action time area from a non-action time area
+ update -- Trigger Condition
  + Triggered every frame when playing the current action (including reRender)
  + Triggered during reRender
+ leave -- Trigger Condition
  + Leaving the current action time area
+ stop -- Trigger Condition
  + Triggered when the runner pauses, if the time is within the current action time range

import { TimeLineEffectSource } from '@src/api/TimelineEffect';

<TimeLineEffectSource />

### EffectSourceParam
> Editor Running Effect Source Parameters

import { EffectSourceParam } from '@src/api/TimelineEffect';

<EffectSourceParam />

## TimelineState
> Timeline Component State

import { TimelineState } from '@src/api/TimelineState';

<TimelineState />

# 101-intro.mdx

Source: https://github.com/xzdarcy/react-timeline-editor/blob/master/packages/document/docs/zh/guide/engine/101-intro.mdx

title: 引擎介绍
order: 1
nav:
  title: 引擎
  order: 2
group:
  title: 运行器

## 运行器

我们提供了解藕于编辑器的运行器，用于运行编辑器生产的数据。

你可以通过定义每个<code><a href="/zh/guide/intro/3-data-interface.html#timelineeffect">TimelineEffect</a></code>中的运行能力（音频播放、动画播放等等），来实现你自己的运行体系。

+ 🛠 提供设置时间、设置运行速率等能力
+ ⚙️ 可独立使用

## 示例

你可以在以下两种场景中使用运行器：

### 编辑时运行
> 编辑器内置了一个运行器，提供了<code><a href="/zh/guide/intro/3-data-interface.html#timelinestate">TimelineState</a></code>用于更便捷的操控运行器。
> 
> 我们不提供默认的运行器样式，你需要自定义样式
> 
> 你可以通过监听器，很轻松的获取运行数据变化，从而定制自己的运行器样式

<code src="@src/engine-demo/engine-basic/index.tsx"></code>

### 独立使用

> 你也可以在任意地方使用运行器运行编辑器生产的数据
> 
> 这对于当你想要`编辑时`和`运行时`共用一套数据和运行能力时非常有用

<code src="@src/engine-demo/engine-standalone/index.tsx"></code>

---

# 102-api.mdx

Source: https://github.com/xzdarcy/react-timeline-editor/blob/master/packages/document/docs/zh/guide/engine/102-api.mdx

title: 运行器 API

### isPlaying

`boolean` 运行器是否正在运行

### isPaused

`boolean` 运行器是否停止

### effects

*setter*  [TimelineEffect](/zh/guide/intro/3-data-interface.html#timelineeffect)  运行效果

### data
*setter*  [TimelineRow](/zh/guide/intro/3-data-interface.html#timelinerow)[] 运行数据

### setPlayRate

`(rate: number) => void` 设置播放速率

### getPlayRate

`() => number` 获取播放速率

### setTime

`(time: number) => void` 设置播放时间

### getTime

`() => number` 获取播放时间

### reRender

`() => void` 重新渲染当前时间

### play

`(param: {toTime?: number; autoEnd?: boolean}) => boolean` 

从当前time开始播放（可通过`setTime`设置），返回是否播放成功
+ toTime (可选): 播放截止时间 
+ autoEnd (可选): 是否在播完全部actions后自动停止

```ts | pure
import { TimelineEngine } from '@xzdarcy/react-timeline-editor';
const engine = new TimelineEngine();
engine.play({autoEnd: true})
```

### pause

`() => void` 暂停

### listener

你可以监听运行器提供的一些事件，并响应逻辑

```ts | pure
import { TimelineEngine } from '@xzdarcy/react-timeline-editor';
const engine = new TimelineEngine();
```

+ `setTimeByTick`: 运行器tick引起的时间变化
```ts | pure
engine.on('setTimeByTick', ({time, engine}) => {...})
```

+ `beforeSetTime`: 设置时间前(手动)(可通过`return false`阻止设置)
```ts | pure
engine.on('beforeSetTime', ({time, engine}) => {...})
```

+ `afterSetTime`: 设置时间后(手动)
```ts | pure
engine.on('afterSetTime', ({time, engine}) => {...})
```

+ `beforeSetPlayRate`: 设置运行速率前(可通过`return false`阻止设置)
```ts | pure
engine.on('beforeSetPlayRate', ({rate, engine}) => {...})
```

+ `afterSetPlayRate`: 设置运行速率后
```ts | pure
engine.on('afterSetPlayRate', ({rate, engine}) => {...})

```

+ `play`: 监听运行事件
```ts | pure
engine.on('play', ({engine}) => {...})
```

+ `paused`: 监听暂停事件
```ts | pure
engine.on('paused', ({engine}) => {...})
```

+ `ended`: 监听播放完成事件
```ts | pure
engine.on('ended', ({engine}) => {...})
```

---

# 1-getting-started.md

Source: https://github.com/xzdarcy/react-timeline-editor/blob/master/packages/document/docs/zh/guide/intro/1-getting-started.md

title: 快速上手

`react-timeline-editor` 是基于react开发的，用于快速搭建时间线编辑能力的组件。

主要可用于构建动画编辑器、视频编辑器等。

![timeline](/assets/timeline.gif)

## 使用方式

```
npm install @xzdarcy/react-timeline-editor
```

```tsx | pure
import React from 'react';
import { Timeline } from '@xzdarcy/react-timeline-editor';

export const TimelineEditor = () => {
  return (
    <Timeline     
      editorData={[]}
      effects={{}}
    />
  )
}
```

# 3-data-interface.mdx

Source: https://github.com/xzdarcy/react-timeline-editor/blob/master/packages/document/docs/zh/guide/intro/3-data-interface.mdx

title: 数据定义

## TimelineRow
> 编辑器数据：编辑行数据结构

import { TimelineRow } from '@src/api/TimelineRow';

<TimelineRow />

## TimelineAction
> 编辑器数据：动作数据结构

import { TimelineAction } from '@src/api/TimelineAction';

<TimelineAction />

## TimelineEffect
> 编辑器运行效果数据结构

import { TimelineEffect } from '@src/api/TimelineEffect';

<TimelineEffect />

### TimeLineEffectSource
> 编辑器效果运行代码数据结构

+ start 触发条件
  + 运行器开始play时，如时间在当前action时间范围内触发
+ enter 触发条件
  + 从非action时间区域进入当前action时间区域
+ update 触发条件
  + 播放当前action时每帧触发（包括reRender）
  + reRender时触发
+ leave 触发条件
  + 从当前action时间区域离开
+ stop 触发条件
  + 运行器pause时，如时间在当前action时间范围内触发

import { TimeLineEffectSource } from '@src/api/TimelineEffect';

<TimeLineEffectSource />

### EffectSourceParam
> 编辑器效果运行代码参数

import { EffectSourceParam } from '@src/api/TimelineEffect';

<EffectSourceParam />

## TimelineState
> timeline组件数据

import { TimelineState } from '@src/api/TimelineState';

<TimelineState />
